rules.title: Encryption at rest must be enabled
rules.summary: Storage and database resources must enable encryption at rest.
rules.description: Unencrypted persistent storage exposes workload data to physical and snapshot-level recovery. Encryption at rest is a control expected by ISO 42001 evidence chains and most SOC 2 mappings.
rules.remediation: Set encrypted = true and supply a KMS key ARN.

rules.title: Encryption in transit must be enforced
rules.description: TLS termination that permits plaintext fallback allows credential interception between services inside the data-center fabric.
rules.remediation: Set the minimum TLS version to 1.2 and disable plaintext listeners.
